# Statistics report, levels 1-2 (auto-generated by scripts/10_stats.py; plan: docs/stats_plan.md)

Read every table with its ascertainment in mind: ClinVar = clinically reported variants, gnomAD = population, Amicus = in-vitro tested substitutions. Counts are numbers of distinct variants (or protein changes / positions as stated), not patients.
